question: You have an Azure subscription that contains a custom application named Application1. Application1 was developed by an external company named Fabrikam, Ltd. Developers at Fabrikam were assigned role-based access control (RBAC) permissions to the Application1 components. All users are licensed for the Microsoft 365 E5 plan. You need to recommend a solution to verify whether the Fabrikam developers still require permissions to Application1. The solution must meet the following requirements: ✑ To the manager of the developers, send a monthly email message that lists the access permissions to Application1. ✑ If the manager does not verify an access permission, automatically revoke that permission. ✑ Minimize development effort. What should you recommend?

options.A: In Azure Active Directory (Azure AD), create an access review of Application1.
options.B: Create an Azure Automation runbook that runs the Get-AzRoleAssignment cmdlet.
options.C: In Azure Active Directory (Azure AD) Privileged Identity Management, create a custom role assignment for the Application1 resources.
options.D: Create an Azure Automation runbook that runs the Get-AzureADUserAppRoleAssignment cmdlet.

explanations.A: Correct. In Azure Active Directory (Azure AD), create an access review of Application1. 正确：Azure AD 的访问审查功能允许管理员定期检查用戶的权限，并可以设置自动撤销未验证的权限。 ( 符合题目要求：发送月度邮件给开发者的经理，并自动撤销未验证的权限。 最小化开发工作量：无需额外开发，只需配置 Azure AD 的内置功能。
explanations.B: Incorrect. Create an Azure Automation runbook that runs the Get-AzRoleAssignment cmdlet. 错误：虽然可以通过运行 Get-AzRoleAssignment cmdlet 获取⻆色分配信息，但这需要额外开发工作来实现邮件发送和权限撤销功能。 不符合“最小化开发工作量”的要求。
explanations.C: Incorrect. In Azure Active Directory (Azure AD) Privileged Identity Management, create a custom role assignment for the Application1 resources. 错误：PIM 主要用于管理临时权限提升，而不是定期审查和撤销权限。 不符合题目要求中的“发送月度邮件”和“自动撤销未验证权限”。
explanations.D: Incorrect. Create an Azure Automation runbook that runs the Get-AzureADUserAppRoleAssignment cmdlet. 错误：与选项 B 类似，虽然可以通过运行 Get-AzureADUserAppRoleAssignment cmdlet 获取用戶的应用⻆色分配信息，但需要额外开发 工作来实现邮件发送和权限撤销功能。 不符合“最小化开发工作量”的要求。

question: You have an Azure subscription. The subscription has a blob container that contains multiple blobs. Ten users in the finance department of your company plan to access the blobs during the month of April. You need to recommend a solution to enable access to the blobs during the month of April only. Which security solution should you include in the recommendation?

explanations.A: Correct. Shared Access Signatures (SAS) Shared Access Signatures (SAS) 是一种安全机制，允许用戶在指定的时间段内访问 Azure 存储资源（如 Blob）。 可以通过设置到期时间和权限来限制访问，非常适合本题要求的“仅在4月期间访问”。 此选项正确。
explanations.B: Incorrect. Conditional Access Policies Conditional Access Policies 是 Azure AD 的功能，用于控制用戶对应用和服务的访问。 它主要用于身份验证和授权，而不是直接控制 Azure Blob 存储的访问权限。 此选项错误。
explanations.C: Incorrect. Certificates Certificates 通常用于身份验证或加密通信，而不是直接用于控制 Azure Blob 存储的访问权限。 此选项错误。
explanations.D: Incorrect. Access Keys Access Keys 是 Azure 存储账戶的主密钥，可以提供完全访问权限。 使用 Access Keys 不适合短期访问控制，因为它无法设置到期时间或限制权限。 此选项错误。

explanations.D: Incorrect. Azure Arc：错误。Azure Arc用于管理混合和多云环境中的资源，与提供SSO或远程访问无关。

question: You have an Azure Active Directory (Azure AD) tenant named contoso.com that has a security group named Group1. Group1 is configured for assigned membership. Group1 has 50 members, including 20 guest users. You need to recommend a solution for evaluating the membership of Group1. The solution must meet the following requirements: ✑ The evaluation must be repeated automatically every three months. ✑ Every member must be able to report whether they need to be in Group1. ✑ Users who report that they do not need to be in Group1 must be removed from Group1 automatically. ✑ Users who do not report whether they need to be in Group1 must be removed from Group1 automatically. What should you include in the recommendation?

options.B: Change the Membership type of Group1 to Dynamic User.
options.D: Implement Azure AD Privileged Identity Management (PIM).

explanations.B: Incorrect. Change the Membership type of Group1 to Dynamic User 动态用戶组 (Dynamic User Groups) 根据用戶属性自动管理组成员资格。 ( 虽然动态组可以自动更新成员，但它无法满足题目中“每个成员报告是否需要在组中”的要求。 错误
explanations.C: Correct. Create an access review 访问审查 (Access Reviews) 是 Azure AD 的功能，允许管理员定期评估组成员资格或应用访问权限。 它支持自动化审查周期（例如每三个月一次），并允许成员报告是否需要继续保留在组中。 符合题目中所有要求，包括自动移除未响应或不需要的成员。 正确

question: HOTSPOT - You plan to deploy Azure Databricks to support a machine learning application. Data engineers will mount an Azure Data Lake Storage account to the Databricks file system. Permissions to folders are granted directly to the data engineers. You need to recommend a design for the planned Databrick deployment. The solution must meet the following requirements: ✑ Ensure that the data engineers can only access folders to which they have permissions. ✑ Minimize development effort. ✑ Minimize costs. What should you include in the recommendation? To answer, select the appropriate options in the answer area. NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point. Hot Area:

explanations.1: Databricks SKU → Premium
explanations.2: Cluster configuration → Credential passthrough
explanations._full: 题目分析与解答 1. 考察的知识点 Azure Databricks SKU选择：了解不同SKU的功能和成本差异。 Cluster配置：熟悉Databricks集群的身份验证和权限管理机制。 2. 选项分析 Databricks SKU: Premium: Premium SKU支持高级功能，例如“Credential passthrough”，可以直接将Azure AD的权限传递到Databricks环境中，确保数据工 程师只能访问他们有权限的文件夹。这符合题目要求。 Standard: Standard SKU不支持“Credential passthrough”，因此无法满足题目中关于权限管理的要求。 Box 1: Premium - Premium Databricks SKU is required for credential passhtrough. Box 2: Credential passthrough - Athenticate automatically to Azure Data Lake Storage Gen1 (ADLS Gen1) and Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2 (ADLS Gen2) from Azure Databricks clusters using the same Azure Active Directory (Azure AD) identity that you use to log into Azure Databricks. When you enable Azure Data Lake Storage credential passthrough for your cluster, commands that you run on that cluster can read and write data in Azure Data Lake Storage without requiring you to configure service principal credentials for access to storage. Reference: https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/databricks/security/credential-passthrough/adls-passthrough 框 1：Premium - Premium Databricks SKU 是凭据传递所需的。 框 2：Credential passthrough - 使用与登录 Azure Databricks 相同的 Azure Active Directory (Azure AD) 身份，自动从 Azure Databricks 集群对 Azure Data Lake Storage Gen1 (ADLS Gen1) 和 Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2 (ADLS Gen2) 进行身份验证。当您为集群启用 Azure Data Lake Storage 凭据传递时， 您在该集群上运行的命令可以读取和写入 Azure Data Lake Storage 中的数据，而无需为访问存储配置服务主体凭据。 参考： https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/databricks/security/credential-passthrough/adls-passthrough Cluster configuration: Credential passthrough: 此选项允许Databricks集群直接使用Azure AD的权限，确保数据工程师只能访问他们有权限的文件夹。这符合 题目要求。 Managed identities: 虽然Managed Identities可以用于身份验证，但它不直接解决数据工程师的文件夹权限问题，因此不符合题目要 求。 MLflow: MLflow是一个机器学习生命周期管理工具，与权限管理无关，因此不符合题目要求。 A runtime that contains Photon: Photon是一个优化的计算引擎，与权限管理无关，因此不符合题目要求。 Secret scope: Secret scope用于管理敏感信息（如密码或密钥），与文件夹权限管理无关，因此不符合题目要求。 3. 我的答案 Databricks SKU: Premium Cluster configuration: Credential passthrough 4. 官方答案 Databricks SKU: Premium Cluster configuration: Credential passthrough 5. 与官方答案比较 我的答案与官方答案一致。 没有需要重新思考的地方。

question: HOTSPOT - You plan to deploy an Azure web app named App1 that will use Azure Active Directory (Azure AD) authentication. App1 will be accessed from the internet by the users at your company. All the users have computers that run Windows 10 and are joined to Azure AD. You need to recommend a solution to ensure that the users can connect to App1 without being prompted for authentication and can access App1 only from company-owned computers. What should you recommend for each requirement? To answer, select the appropriate options in the answer area. NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point. Hot Area:

matches.use_case: The users can connect to App1 without being prompted for authentication
The users can access App1 only from company-owned computers

explanations.1: The users can connect to App1 without being prompted for authentication → An Azure AD app registration
explanations.2: The users can access App1 only from company-owned computers → A Conditional Access policy
explanations._full: 题目分析与解答 1. 考察的知识点 Azure AD应用注册的功能和用途。 Azure AD条件访问策略的配置和限制功能。 如何实现无提示认证和设备限制访问的解决方案。 2. 选项分析 第一部分：The users can connect to App1 without being prompted for authentication Box 1: An Azure AD app registration Azure active directory (AD) provides cloud based directory and identity management services.You can use azure AD to manage users of your application and authenticate access to your applications using azure active directory. You register your application with Azure active directory tenant. Box 2: A conditional access policy Conditional Access policies at their simplest are if-then statements, if a user wants to access a resource, then they must complete an action. By using Conditional Access policies, you can apply the right access controls when needed to keep your organization secure and stay out of your user's way when not needed. Reference: https://codingcanvas.com/using-azure-active-directory-authentication-in-your-web-application/ https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/active- directory/conditional-access/overview 框 1：一个 Azure AD 应用注册 Azure Active Directory (AD) 提供基于云的目录和身份管理服务。您可以使用 Azure AD 来管理应用程序的用戶，并使用 Azure Active Directory 对应用程序的访问进行身份验证。 您需要将应用程序注册到 Azure Active Directory 租戶中。 框 2：一个条件访问策略 条件访问策略最简单的形式是“如果-那么”语句：如果用戶想要访问资源，那么他们必须完成某个操作。 通过使用条件访问策略，您可以在需要时应用适当的访问控制，以确保组织的安全，并在不需要时避免干扰用戶。 参考： https://codingcanvas.com/using-azure-active-directory-authentication-in-your-web-application/ https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/active- directory/conditional-access/overview An Azure AD app registration: 正确。Azure AD应用注册是用于配置应用程序与Azure AD集成的必要步骤。通过应用注册，可以启用单一 登录（SSO），从而实现用戶无需重复输入凭据即可访问应用。 An Azure AD managed identity: 错误。托管身份主要用于为Azure资源提供身份验证，而不是直接用于用戶认证或SSO。 Azure AD Application Proxy: 错误。应用代理用于将本地应用程序发布到Azure AD，但题目中没有提到需要代理功能。 第二部分：The users can access App1 only from company-owned computers A Conditional Access policy: 正确。条件访问策略可以基于设备状态（如是否为公司拥有设备）限制用戶访问资源，是实现此需求的 最佳选择。 An Azure AD administrative unit: 错误。管理单元用于组织和管理Azure AD中的用戶和组，与设备访问控制无关。 Azure Application Gateway: 错误。应用网关主要用于流量管理和负载均衡，与设备访问限制无关。 Azure Blueprints: 错误。Blueprints用于定义和部署Azure资源的标准化配置，与设备访问限制无关。 Azure Policy: 错误。Azure Policy用于管理资源合规性，与用戶设备访问控制无关。 3. 我的答案 The users can connect to App1 without being prompted for authentication: An Azure AD app registration The users can access App1 only from company-owned computers: A Conditional Access policy 4. 官方答案 The users can connect to App1 without being prompted for authentication: An Azure AD app registration The users can access App1 only from company-owned computers: A Conditional Access policy 5. 比较与分析 我的答案与官方答案一致。 没有需要重新思考的部分。

question: You plan to deploy an Azure SQL database that will store Personally Identifiable Information (PII). You need to ensure that only privileged users can view the PII. What should you include in the solution?

explanations.A: Correct. Dynamic Data Masking 动态数据屏蔽是一种保护敏感数据的功能，可以在查询结果中屏蔽敏感数据，使非特权用戶无法看到完整数据。 它是专⻔设计用于限制对敏感数据的访问的，因此符合题目要求。 正确选项。
explanations.B: Incorrect. Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) RBAC用于管理Azure资源的访问权限，但它并不直接用于屏蔽数据库中的敏感数据。 虽然可以通过RBAC限制用戶访问数据库，但它无法实现屏蔽PII的功能。 错误选项。
explanations.C: Incorrect. Data Discovery & Classification 数据发现与分类用于标记和分类敏感数据，帮助识别PII，但它不会限制用戶访问或屏蔽数据。 它是数据管理的辅助工具，而不是直接保护数据的机制。 错误选项。
explanations.D: Incorrect. Transparent Data Encryption (TDE) TDE用于加密数据库文件以保护数据在静态状态下的安全，但它不会限制用戶访问或屏蔽数据。 它保护的是数据存储，而不是数据访问层面的安全。 错误选项。

Key Vault references 默认使用应用的系统分配身份，但您可以指定一个用戶分配身份。 4. 在 Key Vault 中为您之前创建的应用身份创建一个访问策略。在此策略中启用“Get”机密权限。 参考： https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/app-service/app-service-key-vault-references https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/app-service/app-service-key-vault-references Key Vault references in Application settings Secrets: List and Get 4. 官方答案 Key Vault references in Application settings Secrets: List and Get 5. 与官方答案比较 我的答案与官方答案一致，无需重新思考。

options.B: a service principal that is configured to use a certificate
options.C: a service principal that is configured to use a client secret

explanations.A: Incorrect. a system-assigned managed identity 系统分配的托管身份是为单个资源（如虚拟机）自动创建和管理的身份。虽然它可以满足访问Azure资源的需求，但当新增虚拟机 时，每个虚拟机都会创建一个新的系统分配托管身份，这会导致需要额外的管理工作来分配权限。因此不符合“避免分配新⻆色和权 限”的要求。 ( )
explanations.B: Incorrect. a service principal that is configured to use a certificate 服务主体可以通过证书进行身份验证，但这需要手动管理证书和权限分配，增加了管理复杂性。此外，题目明确要求避免存储秘密 和证书，因此此选项不符合要求。
explanations.C: Incorrect. a service principal that is configured to use a client secret 服务主体可以通过客戶端密钥进行身份验证，但这需要手动管理密钥和权限分配，增加了管理复杂性。此外，题目明确要求避免存 储秘密和证书，因此此选项不符合要求。
explanations.D: Correct. a user-assigned managed identity 用戶分配的托管身份是一个独立的资源，可以被多个虚拟机共享使用。这种身份可以简化管理，因为新增虚拟机时无需重新分配⻆ 色和权限。此外，它不需要存储秘密或证书，完全符合题目要求。

explanations._full: 题目分析与解答 1. 考察的知识点 Azure Key Vault的功能与用途，包括存储和管理敏感信息（如证书、密钥和机密）。 如何使用Azure身份服务（如MSI或服务主体）安全地访问Key Vault。 最小化管理工作量的解决方案设计。 2. 选项分析 Storage选项分析： Certificate: 错误。证书通常用于存储公钥和私钥对，适合加密或身份验证场景，但不适合存储API密钥。 Key: 错误。Key Vault中的“Key”主要用于加密和解密操作，而不是存储简单的字符串（如API密钥）。 Secret: 正确。Secret是专⻔用于存储敏感信息（如API密钥、密码等）的最佳选择。 Access选项分析： An API token: 错误。API token通常用于与外部服务交互，而不是用于访问Azure Key Vault。此选项不符合题目要求。 A managed service identity (MSI): 正确。MSI允许Azure资源（如虚拟机）自动管理其身份并安全地访问Key Vault，无需额外的凭据管 理，符合“最小化管理工作量”的要求。 A service principal: 错误。虽然服务主体可以用于访问Key Vault，但它需要手动管理凭据，增加了管理工作量，不符合题目要求。 3. 我的答案 Storage: Secret Access: A managed service identity (MSI) 4. 官方答案 Storage: Secret Access: A managed service identity (MSI) 5. 与官方答案比较 我的答案与官方答案一致。 没有差异，无需重新思考。

explanations._full: 题目分析与解答 1. 考察的知识点 Azure AD应用注册的配置，包括⻆色定义和权限分配。 如何在Azure AD中设置应用⻆色（App roles）和API权限（API permissions）。 如何确保令牌中包含特定⻆色声明（Role Claim）。 2. 选项分析 API permissions: 此选项用于配置应用程序的权限，以便它可以访问其他资源或API。对于App2来说，需要配置API权限以便它能够访 问App1。 App roles: 此选项用于定义应用程序的⻆色。对于App1来说，需要定义Writer⻆色，以便在令牌中包含该⻆色声明。 Token configuration: 此选项用于配置令牌的内容，例如声明和范围。虽然它可以影响令牌的内容，但在此场景中，⻆色声明是通过 App roles定义的，而不是直接通过Token configuration配置的。 3. 我的答案 App1: App roles App2: API permissions 4. 官方答案 App1: App roles App2: API permissions 5. 与官方答案比较 我的答案与官方答案一致。 原因分析：App1需要定义⻆色（Writer），因此选择App roles；App2需要访问App1并获取令牌中的⻆色声明，因此需要配置API permissions。

When you are ready to answer a question, click the Question button to return to the question. Overview Fabrikam, Inc. is an engineering company that has offices throughout Europe. The company has a main office in London and three branch offices in Amsterdam, Berlin, and Rome. Existing Environment: Active Directory Environment The network contains two Active Directory forests named corp.fabrikam.com and rd.fabrikam.com. There are no trust relationships between the forests. Corp.fabrikam.com is a production forest that contains identities used for internal user and computer authentication. Rd.fabrikam.com is used by the research and development (R&D) department only. The R&D department is restricted to using on-premises resources only. Existing Environment: Network Infrastructure Each office contains at least one domain controller from the corp.fabrikam.com domain. The main office contains all the domain controllers for the rd.fabrikam.com forest. All the offices have a high-speed connection to the internet. An existing application named WebApp1 is hosted in the data center of the London office. WebApp1 is used by customers to place and track orders. WebApp1 has a web tier that uses Microsoft Internet Information Services (IIS) and a database tier that runs Microsoft SQL Server 2016. The web tier and the database tier are deployed to virtual machines that run on Hyper-V. The IT department currently uses a separate Hyper-V environment to test updates to WebApp1. Fabrikam purchases all Microsoft licenses through a Microsoft Enterprise Agreement that includes Software Assurance. Existing Environment: Problem Statements The use of WebApp1 is unpredictable. At peak times, users often report delays. At other times, many resources for WebApp1 are underutilized. Requirements: Planned Changes Fabrikam plans to move most of its production workloads to Azure during the next few years, including virtual machines that rely on Active Directory for authentication. As one of its first projects, the company plans to establish a hybrid identity model, facilitating an upcoming Microsoft 365 deployment. All R&D operations will remain on-premises. Fabrikam plans to migrate the production and test instances of WebApp1 to Azure. Requirements: Technical Requirements Fabrikam identifies the following technical requirements: • Website content must be easily updated from a single point. • User input must be minimized when provisioning new web app instances. • Whenever possible, existing on-premises licenses must be used to reduce cost. • Users must always authenticate by using their corp.fabrikam.com UPN identity. • Any new deployments to Azure must be redundant in case an Azure region fails. • Whenever possible, solutions must be deployed to Azure by using the Standard pricing tier of Azure App Service. • An email distribution group named IT Support must be notified of any issues relating to the directory synchronization services. • In the event that a link fails between Azure and the on-premises network, ensure that the virtual machines hosted in Azure can authenticate to Active Directory. • Directory synchronization between Azure Active Directory (Azure AD) and corp.fabrikam.com must not be affected by a link failure between Azure and the on-premises network. Requirements: Database Requirements Fabrikam identifies the following database requirements: • Database metrics for the production instance of WebApp1 must be available for analysis so that database administrators can optimize the performance settings. • To avoid disrupting customer access, database downtime must be minimized when databases are migrated. • Database backups must be retained for a minimum of seven years to meet compliance requirements. Requirements: Security Requirements Fabrikam identifies the following security requirements: • Company information including policies, templates, and data must be inaccessible to anyone outside the company. • Users on the on-premises network must be able to authenticate to corp.fabrikam.com if an internet link fails. • Administrators must be able authenticate to the Azure portal by using their corp.fabrikam.com credentials. • All administrative access to the Azure portal must be secured by using multi-factor authentication (MFA). • The testing of WebApp1 updates must not be visible to anyone outside the company. To meet the authentication requirements of Fabrikam, what should you include in the solution? To answer, select the appropriate options in the answer area. NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.

explanations._full: 题目分析与解答 1. 考察的知识点 Azure AD租戶的数量规划。 条件访问策略的配置与数量规划。 混合身份模型的设计与实现。 2. 选项分析 Minimum number of Azure AD tenants: 0: 错误。Fabrikam计划迁移到Azure并实现混合身份模型，因此至少需要一个Azure AD租戶来支持身份同步和管理。 1: 正确。一个Azure AD租戶足以支持Fabrikam的混合身份模型，同时满足其技术和安全要求。 2: 错误。没有需求表明需要多个Azure AD租戶。一个租戶即可满足所有需求。 3: 错误。同上，多个租戶会增加复杂性且不必要。 4: 错误。同上，多个租戶不符合需求。 Minimum number of conditional access policies to create: 0: 错误。Fabrikam的安全要求包括多因素认证（MFA）和确保管理员访问安全，这需要至少一个条件访问策略。 1: 错误。仅一个条件访问策略不足以同时满足MFA和管理员访问的安全要求。 2: 正确。一个策略用于启用MFA，另一个策略用于确保管理员访问安全。 3: 错误。没有额外需求需要创建三个条件访问策略。 4: 错误。同上，超过两个策略是不必要的。 3. 我选的答案 Minimum number of Azure AD tenants: 1 Minimum number of conditional access policies to create: 2 4. 官方答案 Minimum number of Azure AD tenants: 1 Minimum number of conditional access policies to create: 2 5. 与官方答案比较 我的答案与官方答案一致。 没有需要重新思考的地方。

question: You have an Azure subscription that contains 10 web apps. The apps are integrated with Azure AD and are accessed by users on different project teams. The users frequently move between projects. You need to recommend an access management solution for the web apps. The solution must meet the following requirements: • The users must only have access to the app of the project to which they are assigned currently. • Project managers must verify which users have access to their project’s app and remove users that are no longer assigned to their project. • Once every 30 days, the project managers must be prompted automatically to verify which users are assigned to their projects. What should you include in the recommendation?

explanations.A: Incorrect. Azure AD Identity Protection Azure AD Identity Protection主要用于检测和响应身份相关的安全⻛险，例如可疑登录活动或账戶被盗⻛险。 它不提供用戶访问权限的管理功能，也无法满足定期审核用戶权限的需求。 错误原因：不符合题目要求的功能。
explanations.B: Incorrect. Microsoft Defender for Identity Microsoft Defender for Identity主要用于保护企业的身份基础设施，检测潜在的安全威胁，例如内部攻击或凭据盗窃。 它不涉及用戶访问权限的管理或定期审核功能。 错误原因：不符合题目要求的功能。
explanations.C: Incorrect. Microsoft Entra Permissions Management Microsoft Entra Permissions Management是一个权限管理解决方案，主要用于跨云环境的权限分析和管理。 虽然它可以帮助识别和管理权限，但它不支持定期访问审核或项目经理对用戶权限的验证功能。 错误原因：不完全符合题目要求的功能。
explanations.D: Correct. Azure AD Identity Governance Azure AD Identity Governance提供了访问包（Access Packages）和定期访问审核（Access Reviews）功能。 通过访问包，项目经理可以管理用戶对特定资源的访问权限，并验证哪些用戶可以访问其项目的应用。 定期访问审核功能可以自动提示项目经理每30天审核用戶权限，确保用戶只访问与其当前项目相关的应用。 正确原因：完全符合题目要求的功能。

question: You have an Azure subscription. The subscription contains a tiered app named App1 that is distributed across multiple containers hosted in Azure Container Instances. explanations.A: Incorrect. Network insights 错误。Network insights主要用于监控网络性能和诊断网络问题，但不支持合成事务监控，也无法直接监控应用组件之间的流量。

question: You have 12 Azure subscriptions and three projects. Each project uses resources across multiple subscriptions. explanations.B: Correct. resource tags: 资源标签（resource tags）是 Azure 中用于分类和组织资源的工具，可以为资源添加自定义标签，例如项目名称。 ( 通过标签，可以在 Microsoft Cost Management 中按标签筛选和查看成本数据，从而实现按项目监控成本。 此选项正确。

question: HOTSPOT - You have an Azure subscription. You plan to deploy five storage accounts that will store block blobs and five storage accounts that will host file shares. The file shares will be accessed by using the SMB protocol. You need to recommend an access authorization solution for the storage accounts. The solution must meet the following requirements: • Maximize security. • Prevent the use of shared keys. • Whenever possible, support time-limited access. What should you include in the solution? To answer, select the appropriate options in the answer area. NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.
available_options: A user delegation shared access signature (SAS) only
A shared access signature (SAS) and a stored access policy

matches.correct_answer: A user delegation shared access signature (SAS) only

explanations.1: For the blobs → A user delegation shared access signature (SAS) only
explanations.2: For the file shares → Azure AD credentials
explanations._full: 题目分析与解答 1. 考察的知识点 Azure存储账戶的访问授权机制，包括Shared Access Signature (SAS)、User Delegation SAS、Stored Access Policy以及Azure AD集成。 如何选择最安全的访问授权方式，同时满足时间限制和避免使用共享密钥的要求。 2. 选项分析 For the blobs: A user delegation shared access signature (SAS) only: 正确。User Delegation SAS是基于Azure AD身份验证的SAS，提供更高的安全性，并 支持时间限制。它避免了使用存储账戶密钥，符合题目要求。 A shared access signature (SAS) and a stored access policy: 错误。普通的SAS依赖存储账戶密钥，不符合“防止使用共享密钥”的要求。 虽然Stored Access Policy可以提供额外的管理功能，但它无法解决共享密钥的问题。 A user delegation shared access signature (SAS) and a stored access policy: 错误。虽然User Delegation SAS符合要求，但Stored Access Policy在这种情况下并不是必要的，且题目没有要求额外的管理功能。 For the file shares: Azure AD credentials: 正确。Azure文件共享可以通过Azure AD进行身份验证，提供更高的安全性，并避免使用共享密钥。它也支持时 间限制，符合题目要求。 A user delegation shared access signature (SAS) only: 错误。User Delegation SAS适用于Blob存储，而不是文件共享。文件共享需要使用 Azure AD进行身份验证。 A user delegation shared access signature (SAS) and a stored access policy: 错误。同样，User Delegation SAS不适用于文件共享，且 Stored Access Policy在这种情况下没有意义。 3. 我的答案 For the blobs: A user delegation shared access signature (SAS) only For the file shares: Azure AD credentials 4. 官方答案 For the blobs: A user delegation shared access signature (SAS) only For the file shares: Azure AD credentials 5. 与官方答案比较 我的答案与官方答案一致。 没有需要重新思考的地方。

question: You have an Azure subscription. The subscription contains 100 virtual machines that run Windows Server 2022 and have the Azure Monitor Agent installed. You need to recommend a solution that meets the following requirements: • Forwards JSON-formatted logs from the virtual machines to a Log Analytics workspace • Transforms the logs and stores the data in a table in the Log Analytics workspace What should you include in the recommendation? To answer, select the appropriate options in the answer area. NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.

explanations.1: To collect the event logs → Azure Lighthouse
explanations.2: To support the DCRs → The Azure Monitor agent
explanations._full: 题目分析与解答 1. 考察的知识点 Azure Monitor的日志收集与处理功能。 如何使用数据收集端点（Data Collection Endpoint, DCE）来转发日志。 如何使用KQL（Kusto Query Language）来查询和转换日志数据。 2. 选项分析 To forward the logs: A linked storage account for the Log Analytics workspace: 错误。链接的存储账戶主要用于存储诊断日志或备份数据，而不是直接用于转 发JSON格式的日志到Log Analytics工作区。 An Azure Monitor data collection endpoint: 正确。数据收集端点（DCE）是Azure Monitor中用于安全地收集和转发日志数据的推荐解决 方案，支持JSON格式的日志转发。 A service endpoint: 错误。服务端点用于虚拟网络与Azure服务之间的安全连接，与日志转发无关。 To transform the logs and store the data: A KQL query: 正确。KQL（Kusto Query Language）是Log Analytics工作区中用于查询和转换数据的语言，支持复杂的日志处理和存储。 A WQL query: 错误。WQL（Windows Management Instrumentation Query Language）主要用于查询Windows系统信息，与Log Analytics工作 区无关。 An XPath query: 错误。XPath主要用于查询XML数据，与JSON格式的日志处理无关。 3. 我的答案 An Azure Monitor data collection endpoint A KQL query 4. 官方答案 An Azure Monitor data collection endpoint A KQL query 5. 与官方答案的比较 我的答案与官方答案一致。 没有需要重新思考的部分。

question: HOTSPOT - You have five Azure subscriptions. Each subscription is linked to a separate Azure AD tenant and contains virtual machines that run Windows Server 2022. You plan to collect Windows security events from the virtual machines and send them to a single Log Analytics workspace. You need to recommend a solution that meets the following requirements: • Collects event logs from multiple subscriptions • Supports the use of data collection rules (DCRs) to define which events to collect What should you recommend for each requirement? To answer, select the appropriate options in the answer area. NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.

explanations.1: To collect the event logs → Azure Lighthouse
explanations.2: To support the DCRs → The Azure Monitor agent
explanations._full: 题目分析与解答 1. 考察的知识点 跨订阅资源管理：如何在多个 Azure 订阅中收集数据。 数据收集规则 (DCR)：如何使用 Azure Monitor 的新功能定义和管理数据收集。 代理选择：了解不同的 Azure 代理及其功能。 2. 选项分析 To collect the event logs: Azure Event Grid: 错误。Azure Event Grid 是用于事件路由的服务，主要用于事件驱动的架构，而不是用于跨订阅收集日志。 Azure Lighthouse: 正确。Azure Lighthouse 允许跨订阅和跨租戶管理资源，是实现跨订阅日志收集的推荐解决方案。 Azure Purview: 错误。Azure Purview 是数据治理服务，与日志收集无关。 To support the DCRs: The Log Analytics agent: 错误。Log Analytics agent 是旧版代理，不支持数据收集规则 (DCR)。 The Azure Monitor agent: 正确。Azure Monitor agent 是新版代理，支持数据收集规则 (DCR)，并且是推荐的解决方案。 The Azure Connected Machine agent: 错误。Azure Connected Machine agent 主要用于管理非 Azure 环境中的虚拟机，不支持 DCR。 3. 我的答案 To collect the event logs: Azure Lighthouse To support the DCRs: The Azure Monitor agent 4. 官方答案 To collect the event logs: Azure Lighthouse To support the DCRs: The Azure Monitor agent 5. 与官方答案比较 我的答案与官方答案一致。 没有需要重新思考的部分。

question: You have an Azure subscription that contains two applications named App1 and App2. App1 is a sales processing application. When a transaction in App1 requires shipping, a message is added to an Azure Storage account queue, and then App2 listens to the queue for relevant transactions. In the future, additional applications will be added that will process some of the shipping requests based on the specific details of the transactions. You need to recommend a replacement for the storage account queue to ensure that each additional application will be able to read the relevant transactions. What should you recommend?

explanations.A: Incorrect. one Azure Data Factory pipeline 错误：Azure Data Factory 是用于数据集成和数据管道的工具，主要用于数据的提取、转换和加载（ETL），而不是消息队列服务。 不适合处理消息队列场景。
explanations.B: Incorrect. multiple storage account queues 错误：虽然可以通过多个存储账戶队列来支持多个应用程序，但这种方法需要额外的逻辑来确保消息的正确分发，增加了复杂性。 不符合题目要求的“推荐替代方案”，因为它无法高效地支持多个应用程序读取相关消息。
explanations.C: Incorrect. one Azure Service Bus queue 错误：Azure Service Bus Queue 是单一消费者模式，消息只能被一个应用程序消费，无法支持多个应用程序同时读取相关消息。 不满足题目中“多个应用程序读取相关消息”的需求。

question: HOTSPOT - You need to design a storage solution for an app that will store large amounts of frequently used data. The solution must meet the following requirements: ✑ Maximize data throughput. ✑ Prevent the modification of data for one year. ✑ Minimize latency for read and write operations. Which Azure Storage account type and storage service should you recommend? To answer, select the appropriate options in the answer area. NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point. Hot Area:

explanations.1: Storage account type → BlockBlobStorage
explanations.2: Storage service → Blob
explanations._full: 题目分析与解答 1. 考察的知识点 Azure存储账戶类型的选择。 Azure存储服务的选择。 如何满足高吞吐量、低延迟以及数据不可修改的需求。 2. 选项分析 Storage account type: BlobStorage: 提供Blob存储服务，但不支持高级性能选项，无法最大化数据吞吐量，因此不符合要求。 Box 1: BlockBlobStorage - Block Blob is a premium storage account type for block blobs and append blobs. Recommended for scenarios with high transactions rates, or scenarios that use smaller objects or require consistently low storage latency. Box 2: Blob - The Archive tier is an offline tier for storing blob data that is rarely accessed. The Archive tier offers the lowest storage costs, but higher data retrieval costs and latency compared to the online tiers (Hot and Cool). Data must remain in the Archive tier for at least 180 days or be subject to an early deletion charge. Reference: https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/storage/blobs/archive-blob 框 1：BlockBlobStorage - Block Blob 是一种用于块 blob 和追加 blob 的高级存储账戶类型。推荐用于高事务率的场景，或者使用较小对象或需要一致低存储 延迟的场景。 框 2：Blob - Archive 层是一个离线层，用于存储很少访问的 blob 数据。Archive 层提供最低的存储成本，但与在线层（Hot 和 Cool）相比，数据 检索成本和延迟更高。数据必须至少在 Archive 层中保留 180 天，否则将受到提前删除费用的影响。 参考： https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/storage/blobs/archive-blob BlockBlobStorage: 专⻔优化了块Blob存储，支持高级性能选项，能够最大化数据吞吐量并提供低延迟读写操作，符合要求。 FileStorage: 专⻔用于文件共享存储，不适合存储大量频繁使用的数据，因此不符合要求。 StorageV2 with Premium performance: 支持多种存储服务并提供高级性能，但不专⻔优化块Blob存储，因此不如BlockBlobStorage适 合。 StorageV2 with Standard performance: 性能不如Premium选项，无法最大化数据吞吐量，因此不符合要求。 Storage service: Blob: 专⻔用于存储非结构化数据（如图像、视频等），支持高吞吐量和低延迟读写操作，符合要求。 File: 用于文件共享存储，不适合存储大量频繁使用的数据，因此不符合要求。 Table: 用于存储结构化数据（如NoSQL数据），不适合存储非结构化数据，因此不符合要求。 3. 我的答案 Storage account type: BlockBlobStorage Storage service: Blob 4. 官方答案 Storage account type: BlockBlobStorage Storage service: Blob 5. 与官方答案比较 我的答案与官方答案一致。 无需重新思考，答案正确。

question: You are designing an application that will be hosted in Azure. The application will host video files that range from 50 MB to 12 GB. The application will use certificate-based authentication and will be available to users on the internet. You need to recommend a storage option for the video files. The solution must provide the fastest read performance and must minimize storage costs. What should you recommend?

explanations.A: Incorrect. Azure Files Azure Files 是一种文件共享服务，适用于文件存储和共享场景。虽然支持文件存储，但它的性能不如 Azure Blob Storage，尤其是对于 大文件（如视频文件）。此外，成本可能较高，因此不适合此场景。 错误原因：不符合“最快读性能”和“最小化存储成本”的要求。
explanations.B: Incorrect. Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2 Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2 主要用于大规模数据分析场景，支持大数据处理和分析。虽然它可以存储大文件，但其设计目标是数据 分析，而不是优化视频文件的读取性能。 错误原因：不符合“最快读性能”的要求。
explanations.C: Correct. Azure Blob Storage Azure Blob Storage 是专⻔设计用于存储非结构化数据（如视频、图像等）的服务。它提供了高性能的读取能力，并且成本相对较 低，非常适合存储视频文件。 正确原因：符合“最快读性能”和“最小化存储成本”的要求。
explanations.D: Incorrect. Azure SQL Database Azure SQL Database 是关系型数据库服务，适用于存储结构化数据。存储视频文件并不是其设计目标，性能和成本都不适合此场景。 错误原因：不适合存储视频文件。

question: You are designing a SQL database solution. The solution will include 20 databases that will be 20 GB each and have varying usage patterns. You need to recommend a database platform to host the databases. The solution must meet the following requirements: ✑ The solution must meet a Service Level Agreement (SLA) of 99.99% uptime. ✑ The compute resources allocated to the databases must scale dynamically. ✑ The solution must have reserved capacity. Compute charges must be minimized. What should you include in the recommendation?

options.A: an elastic pool that contains 20 Azure SQL databases
options.B: 20 databases on a Microsoft SQL server that runs on an Azure virtual machine in an availability set
options.C: 20 databases on a Microsoft SQL server that runs on an Azure virtual machine
options.D: 20 instances of Azure SQL Database serverless

explanations.A: Correct. an elastic pool that contains 20 Azure SQL databases 正确：弹性池允许多个Azure SQL数据库共享计算资源，支持动态扩展，且成本优化。 满足99.99%的SLA要求，因为Azure SQL Database本身提供此级别的SLA。 支持预留容量，适合具有不同使用模式的数据库。
explanations.B: Incorrect. 20 databases on a Microsoft SQL server that runs on an Azure virtual machine in an availability set 错误：虽然可用性集提高了虚拟机的高可用性，但运行SQL Server的虚拟机需要手动管理资源分配，无法动态扩展。 成本较高，因为需要为每个虚拟机分配固定的计算资源。 不支持弹性池的功能，无法优化成本。
explanations.C: Incorrect. 20 databases on a Microsoft SQL server that runs on an Azure virtual machine 错误：与选项B类似，运行SQL Server的虚拟机需要手动管理资源分配，无法动态扩展。 不满足99.99%的SLA要求，因为虚拟机的SLA通常低于Azure SQL Database的SLA。 成本较高，且不支持弹性池功能。
explanations.D: Incorrect. 20 instances of Azure SQL Database serverless 错误：虽然Serverless支持动态计算资源分配，但每个数据库都需要单独管理，无法共享资源。 成本可能较高，因为无法利用弹性池的资源共享优势。 不支持预留容量，无法满足题目要求。

question: HOTSPOT - You have an on-premises database that you plan to migrate to Azure. You need to design the database architecture to meet the following requirements: ✑ Support scaling up and down. ✑ Support geo-redundant backups. ✑ Support a database of up to 75 TB. ✑ Be optimized for online transaction processing (OLTP). What should you include in the design? To answer, select the appropriate options in the answer area. NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point. Hot Area:
available_options: SQL Server on Azure Virtual Machines

question: You are planning an Azure IoT Hub solution that will include 50,000 IoT devices. Each device will stream data, including temperature, device ID, and time data. question: You have an app named App1 that uses an on-premises Microsoft SQL Server database named DB1. You plan to migrate DB1 to an Azure SQL managed instance. You need to enable customer managed Transparent Data Encryption (TDE) for the instance. The solution must maximize encryption strength. Which type of encryption algorithm and key length should you use for the TDE protector?

explanations.A: Correct. RSA 3072: 正确。RSA 3072 是一种推荐的加密算法和密钥⻓度，提供了强大的加密强度，同时符合现代加密标准。Azure 支持使用 RSA 3072 作为 TDE 保护器的最佳实践。
explanations.B: Incorrect. AES 256: 错误。虽然 AES 256 是一种强大的对称加密算法，但它通常用于数据加密而不是 TDE 保护器的密钥管理。TDE 保护器需 要使用非对称加密算法（如 RSA）。
explanations.C: Incorrect. RSA 4096: 错误。虽然 RSA 4096 提供更高的加密强度，但它的性能开销较大，通常不作为 TDE 保护器的推荐选项。Azure 的最佳实 践是使用 RSA 3072。
explanations.D: Incorrect. RSA 2048: 错误。RSA 2048 是一种较旧的加密标准，虽然仍然安全，但其加密强度低于 RSA 3072，不符合现代加密最佳实践。

question: You are planning an Azure IoT Hub solution that will include 50,000 IoT devices. Each device will stream data, including temperature, device ID, and time data. question: HOTSPOT - You are planning an Azure Storage solution for sensitive data. The data will be accessed daily. The dataset is less than 10 GB. You need to recommend a storage solution that meets the following requirements: • All the data written to storage must be retained for five years. • Once the data is written, the data can only be read. Modifications and deletion must be prevented. • After five years, the data can be deleted, but never modified. • Data access charges must be minimized. What should you recommend? To answer, select the appropriate options in the answer area. NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.
available_options: General purpose v2 with Cool access tier for blobs
General purpose v2 with Hot access tier for blobs

matches.use_case: Configuration to prevent modifications and deletions

explanations.1: Storage account type → General purpose v2 with Hot access tier for blobs
explanations.2: Configuration to prevent modifications and deletions → Container access policy
explanations._full: 题目分析与解答 1. 考察的知识点 Azure Storage解决方案的选择，包括存储类型和访问层。 数据保护策略，包括如何防止数据的修改和删除。 成本优化，尤其是数据访问费用的最小化。 2. 选项分析 Storage account type: Premium block blobs: 错误。Premium block blobs主要用于高性能场景，例如低延迟和高吞吐量需求。题目中数据量较小（小于 10GB），且没有高性能需求，因此不适合选择此类型。 General purpose v2 with Cool access tier for blobs: 错误。Cool access tier适用于不频繁访问的数据，而题目中明确指出数据将每天访 问，因此Cool access tier不符合要求。 General purpose v2 with Hot access tier for blobs: 正确。Hot access tier适用于频繁访问的数据，符合题目中每天访问的需求，同时 General purpose v2支持多种存储功能，适合⻓期数据保留和访问需求。 Configuration to prevent modifications and deletions: Container access level: 错误。Container access level主要用于设置容器的访问权限（例如公共访问或私有访问），无法直接防止数据的 修改和删除。 Container access policy: 正确。Container access policy可以设置存储容器的访问权限和时间范围，能够满足题目中防止数据修改和删除 的要求。 Storage account resource lock: 错误。Resource lock用于锁定整个存储账戶，防止删除或修改资源，但无法针对具体数据进行操作，且 不适合题目中五年后允许删除的需求。 3. 我的答案 Storage account type: General purpose v2 with Hot access tier for blobs Configuration to prevent modifications and deletions: Container access policy 4. 官方答案 Storage account type: General purpose v2 with Hot access tier for blobs Configuration to prevent modifications and deletions: Container access policy 5. 与官方答案的比较 我的答案与官方答案一致。 没有差异，无需重新思考。

question: HOTSPOT - You are designing a data analytics solution that will use Azure Synapse and Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2. You need to recommend Azure Synapse pools to meet the following requirements: • Ingest data from Data Lake Storage into hash-distributed tables. • Implement query, and update data in Delta Lake. explanations.1: Ingest data from Data Lake Storage into hash-distributed tables → A dedicated SQL pool
explanations.2: Implement, query, and update data in Delta Lake → A serverless Apache Spark pool
explanations._full: 题目分析与解答 1. 考察的知识点 Azure Synapse Analytics中的不同池的功能和适用场景。 如何使用Azure Synapse与Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2进行数据集成。 Delta Lake的查询和更新操作的支持。 2. 选项分析 Ingest data from Data Lake Storage into hash-distributed tables: A dedicated SQL pool: 正确。Dedicated SQL pool是Azure Synapse中的专用资源池，适合处理结构化数据并支持高性能的分布式表（如 hash-distributed tables）。它可以直接从Data Lake Storage中摄取数据并存储到分布式表中。 A serverless Apache Spark pool: 错误。虽然Apache Spark池可以处理大规模数据并与Data Lake集成，但它主要用于数据处理和分析， 而不是直接支持hash-distributed tables的存储。 A serverless SQL pool: 错误。Serverless SQL池适合查询Data Lake中的数据，但它不支持hash-distributed tables的存储和操作。 Implement, query, and update data in Delta Lake: A dedicated SQL pool: 错误。Dedicated SQL pool不支持Delta Lake的查询和更新操作，因为Delta Lake是基于Apache Spark的技术，专⻔ 用于处理事务性数据湖。 A serverless Apache Spark pool: 正确。Serverless Apache Spark池支持Delta Lake的查询和更新操作，因为它与Apache Spark生态系统兼 容，并且能够处理Delta Lake的事务性功能。 A serverless SQL pool: 错误。Serverless SQL池可以查询Data Lake中的数据，但它不支持Delta Lake的事务性更新操作。 3. 我的答案 Ingest data from Data Lake Storage into hash-distributed tables: A dedicated SQL pool Implement, query, and update data in Delta Lake: A serverless Apache Spark pool 4. 官方答案 Ingest data from Data Lake Storage into hash-distributed tables: A dedicated SQL pool Implement, query, and update data in Delta Lake: A serverless Apache Spark pool 5. 与官方答案比较 我的答案与官方答案一致。 没有差异，无需重新思考。

explanations._full: 题目分析与解答 1. 考察的知识点 Azure SQL Managed Instance的安全功能，包括动态数据屏蔽 (Dynamic Data Masking) 和始终加密 (Always Encrypted)。 如何保护敏感数据并满足不同用戶⻆色的访问需求。 2. 选项分析 Phone numbers: Always Encrypted: 错误。Always Encrypted用于保护数据在传输和存储时的安全性，但它不会动态屏蔽数据，无法满足“仅显示最后四 位”的需求。 Column encryption: 错误。Column encryption是加密列数据的功能，但它不提供动态屏蔽功能，无法满足题目要求。 Dynamic data masking: 正确。Dynamic Data Masking允许对数据进行动态屏蔽，可以根据用戶⻆色显示部分数据，例如仅显示最后四 位电话号码。 Transparent Data Encryption (TDE): 错误。TDE用于加密整个数据库以保护数据静态存储的安全性，但它不提供动态屏蔽功能。 Social security numbers: Always Encrypted: 正确。Always Encrypted可以确保数据在传输和存储时保持加密状态，防止未经授权的用戶（如云管理员）访问敏 感数据。 Column encryption: 错误。Column encryption是加密列数据的功能，但它不提供对云管理员的访问限制，无法满足题目要求。 Dynamic data masking: 错误。Dynamic Data Masking用于动态屏蔽数据，但它无法完全防止云管理员访问敏感数据。 Transparent Data Encryption (TDE): 错误。TDE用于加密整个数据库以保护数据静态存储的安全性，但它无法防止云管理员访问敏感数 据。 3. 我的答案 Phone numbers: Dynamic data masking Social security numbers: Always Encrypted 4. 官方答案 Phone numbers: Dynamic data masking Social security numbers: Always Encrypted 5. 与官方答案比较 我的答案与官方答案一致。 无需重新思考，答案正确。

question: You plan to use an Azure Storage account to store data assets. You need to recommend a solution that meets the following requirements: • Supports immutable storage • Disables anonymous access to the storage account • Supports access control list (ACL)-based Azure AD permissions What should you include in the recommendation?

explanations.A: Incorrect. Azure Files Azure Files支持文件共享，但不支持不可变存储，也不支持基于ACL的Azure AD权限控制。因此此选项错误。
explanations.B: Correct. Azure Data Lake Storage Azure Data Lake Storage支持不可变存储，能够禁用匿名访问，并且支持基于ACL的Azure AD权限控制。这是正确的选项。
explanations.C: Incorrect. Azure NetApp Files Azure NetApp Files主要用于高性能文件存储，不支持不可变存储，也不支持基于ACL的Azure AD权限控制。因此此选项错误。
explanations.D: Incorrect. Azure Blob Storage Azure Blob Storage支持不可变存储和禁用匿名访问，但不支持基于ACL的Azure AD权限控制。因此此选项错误。

question: HOTSPOT - You are designing a storage solution that will ingest, store, and analyze petabytes (PBs) of structured, semi-structured, and unstructured text data. The analyzed data will be offloaded to Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2 for long-term retention. You need to recommend a storage and analytics solution that meets the following requirements: • Stores the processed data • Provides interactive analytics • Supports manual scaling, built-in autoscaling, and custom autoscaling What should you include in the recommendation? To answer, select the appropriate options in the answer area. NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.

explanations.1: For storage and interactive analytics → Azure Data Explorer
explanations.2: Query language → KQL
explanations._full: 题目分析与解答 1. 考察的知识点 Azure存储解决方案的选择，包括Azure Data Explorer和Azure Data Lake Analytics的功能和适用场景。 查询语言的选择，包括KQL、Transact-SQL和U-SQL的适用场景。 解决方案的扩展性和分析能力，包括手动扩展、自动扩展和自定义扩展的支持。 2. 选项分析 For storage and interactive analytics: Azure Data Explorer: 正确。Azure Data Explorer是一种快速、可扩展的数据分析服务，支持交互式分析，适合处理结构化、半结构化和 非结构化数据。它还支持手动扩展、内置自动扩展和自定义扩展。 Azure Data Lake Analytics: 错误。Azure Data Lake Analytics主要用于大规模数据处理和分析，但它不支持交互式分析，也不具备内置的 自动扩展功能。 Log Analytics: 错误。Log Analytics主要用于日志数据的分析，不适合处理大规模的结构化、半结构化和非结构化数据。 Query language: KQL: 正确。KQL（Kusto Query Language）是Azure Data Explorer的查询语言，专为交互式分析设计，支持快速查询和数据探索。 Transact-SQL: 错误。Transact-SQL主要用于关系型数据库的查询，不适合Azure Data Explorer的场景。 U-SQL: 错误。U-SQL主要用于Azure Data Lake Analytics的查询，不适合Azure Data Explorer的场景。 3. 我的答案 For storage and interactive analytics: Azure Data Explorer Query language: KQL 4. 官方答案 For storage and interactive analytics: Azure Data Explorer Query language: KQL 5. 与官方答案比较 我的答案与官方答案一致，无需重新思考。
